results.question: How many customers are from Egypt?
results.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'Egypt'
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'Egypt';

results.question: List all electronic products with their prices
results.expected_sql: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics'
results.generated_sql: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' LIMIT 1000;

results.question: What is the total revenue from completed orders?
results.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed'
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed';

results.question: Which customer has spent the most on completed orders?
results.expected_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) as total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1
results.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'Completed'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Show the top 3 most ordered products by quantity
results.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_qty FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 3
results.generated_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 3;

results.question: What is the average order value per customer?
results.expected_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) as avg_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name;

results.question: Which products have never been ordered?
results.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.product_id IS NULL
results.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name FROM products p WHERE p.product_id NOT IN (SELECT oi.product_id FROM order_items oi) LIMIT 1000;

results.question: Find customers with more than one completed order
results.expected_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.name HAVING order_count > 1
results.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id)
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'Completed'
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1;

results.question: What is the average salary per department?
results.expected_sql: SELECT d.dept_name, ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 2) as avg_salary FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_name
results.generated_sql: SELECT d.dept_name, ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 2) FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_name;

results.question: Find the department with the highest total salary budget
results.expected_sql: SELECT d.dept_name, SUM(e.salary) as total_salary FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY total_salary DESC LIMIT 1
results.generated_sql:
SELECT d.dept_name, SUM(e.salary) AS total_salary
FROM departments d
JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id
GROUP BY d.dept_name
ORDER BY total_salary DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Show departments with their project count and total project budget

results.generated_sql: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(p.project_id), SUM(p.budget) FROM departments d JOIN projects p ON d.dept_id = p.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_name;

results.question: Who are the managers and which departments do they manage?
results.expected_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.dept_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE e.is_manager = 1
results.generated_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.dept_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE e.is_manager = 1 LIMIT 1000;

results.question: Find employees who earn more than their department average
results.expected_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, e.salary, d.dept_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE e.salary > (SELECT AVG(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.dept_id = e.dept_id)
results.generated_sql:
SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, e.salary, d.dept_name
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id
WHERE e.salary > (
    SELECT AVG(e2.salary)
    FROM employees e2
    WHERE e2.dept_id = e.dept_id
)
LIMIT 1000;

results.question: What is the total inventory value per warehouse?
results.expected_sql: SELECT w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity * p.unit_price) as total_value FROM warehouses w JOIN inventory i ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_name
results.generated_sql:
SELECT w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity * p.unit_price) AS total_inventory_value
FROM warehouses w
JOIN inventory i ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY w.warehouse_name;
